name: Francesca Gargallo
shortBio: Sicilian-born Mexican feminist philosopher and historian of ideas who documented Latin American feminist philosophy and Indigenous women’s autonomous philosophies across Abya Yala.
centralQuestion: What happens to the canon of feminist philosophy when we center the collective epistemologies of Indigenous and popular women across Abya Yala?

keyWorks.title: Las ideas feministas latinoamericanas
keyWorks.description: Intellectual history reconstructing autonomous Latin American feminist philosophical lineages.

keyWorks.title: Feminismos desde Abya Yala
keyWorks.description: Dialogical philosophical study of Indigenous women’s political cosmologies across 600+ nations of Abya Yala.
